title: What's the time?
description: An even-numbered picture lesson about reading twelve clocks and asking whether there is any of twenty-four foods and goods, with written drills on plural -s/-es and some/any. 读十二个钟表，并对二十四种食物和用品询问“有没有”，书面练习复数 -s/-es 与 some/any。
answer_note: The twelve clock readings are suggested readings of the pictured clocks; no audio recording was supplied. The 24 food and drink items are transcribed from the printed labels of the numbered pictures. Textbook written exercises A and B have no printed key; model answers are suggested. Workbook A answers follow the supplied Lesson 60 key: item 1 is the printed example; the key answers with I / don't in item 5. Workbook B.2 follows the key; B.1 and B.3 are open-ended in the key and are marked suggested with model answers. Grammar answers follow the supplied Lesson 60 grammar key on PDF viewer pages 491-493; the printed examples I.1a, I.2a and II.1 are not editable. No external sources were used.

practice.title: A. Some and any
practice.instruction: Look. 请看下表。 Now write questions and answers like the example. 模仿例句提问并回答。
practice.translation: Look at the table, then write questions and answers like the example.
practice.context: Table: You can't count these (uncountable nouns): paper, glue, chalk, bread, cheese, jam, steak, mince, soap — Do you want any paper? Yes, I do. I want some paper. I want three pads of paper. / or No, I don't. I don't want any paper. / You can count these (countable nouns): pens, pads of paper, envelopes, peas, biscuits, eggs, grapes — Do you want any pens? Yes, I do. I want some pens. I want three pens. / or No, I don't. I don't want any pens.

questions.prompt: you / writing paper? — white envelopes
questions.answer:
Do you want any writing paper?
No, I don't want any writing paper, but I need some white envelopes.

questions.prompt: we / eggs? — brown bread
questions.answer:
Do we want any eggs?
No, we don't want any eggs, but we need some brown bread.

questions.prompt: she / fresh meat? — fresh vegetables
questions.answer:
Does she want any fresh meat?
No, she doesn't want any fresh meat, but she needs some fresh vegetables.

questions.prompt: we / French apples? — English potatoes
questions.answer:
Do we want any French apples?
No, we don't want any French apples, but we need some English potatoes.

questions.prompt: you / honey? — bars of chocolate
questions.answer:
Do you want any honey?
No, I don't want any honey, but I need some bars of chocolate.

practice.title: B. Situations
practice.instruction: Read the situations. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: Read the situations and write what you say.
practice.context: B.1 and B.3 have no fixed printed answer; they are open-ended and are labelled suggested in the key.

questions.prompt: You offer an English person a choice of steak or lamb. What do you ask?
questions.answer: Do you want steak or lamb?

questions.prompt: You are in a shop. You have everything you want. The assistant says: 'Is that all?'
questions.answer: (Yes,) that's all, thank you.

questions.prompt: You are in a shop. The shop assistant wants to know what else you want. What does he or she say?
questions.answer: What else do you want?
